We are at the beginning of that journey. The primary requirement for this role remains hands-on experience in complex investigations. In addition, the role holder will help shape how the function adopts investigative technology and AI - pragmatically, and in a responsible, human-led way. We welcome candidates from an investigations, IT-forensics or legal-tech background who combine strong investigative capability with a genuine interest in developing this area.How can you make an impact?As an Investigator / Investigation Counsel, your responsibilities will include:Investigations- Member of the rapid-reaction task force to lead investigations on ad hoc Compliance issues- Assess, prioritize, execute and lead complex compliance investigations- Collaborate with Regions / Global Lines / other entities on delegated investigations- Provide expert guidance and support to Compliance Officers at local, regional and global levels- Monitor, follow-up and escalate issues as necessary, ensuring resolution and compliance- Make effective use of investigative technology and, as it is introduced, AI-enabled methods (e.g. e-discovery, data analytics) to work efficiently and at scale, keeping human judgment at the centre- Continuously enhance and share insights and lessons learnedGovernance- Develop and implement governance frameworks to support effective investigation processesReview and update policies related to internal investigations and whistleblowing to ensure alignment with industry standardsContribute to the further development of the investigations operating model, including the responsible integration of technology and AI as the setup matures  *  Provide guidance on governance issues related to internal investigations and whistleblowing to enhance organizational integrityAwareness- Contribute to initiatives aimed at elevating the awareness and effectiveness of the Whistleblowing programReporting- Ensure comprehensive and accurate data entry into the Compliance Case Management Tool (CCMT)- Develop and present detailed reports and presentations on Compliance investigations and related topics to senior management- Analyze case data and CCMT usage to identify trends, providing strategic insights and reports where required- Prepare responses to media requests and provide input to Sustainability reports, Audits and other similar / related information requestsIntegrity Committee- Fulfill obligations under the Integrity Committee Terms of Reference (both ad hoc and standing committees)- Prepare and present Integrity Committee reports and minutesWhat are you made of?Minimum Qualifications- Solid experience (3+ years) and proven competence in conducting and, increasingly, leading complex investigations effectively and efficiently, ideally with international exposure- Strong expertise in remediation and mitigation measures in an international and multicultural environment- Exceptional ability to communicate clearly and constructively with all levels, including senior management, within a multicultural organization- Proven ability to learn, acquire and apply new knowledge and skills in digital and investigative methodologies, laws and regulationsPreferred Qualifications- In-depth knowledge of the insurance business is an advantage- Some practical, operational experience with investigative technology - e.g. e-discovery, data analytics, IT forensics or legal-tech tools - whether gained as an investigator, IT-forensics specialist or legal-technology professional- Interest in helping build an AI-enabled investigation capability, with a pragmatic and responsible view of where technology adds real value;- Strong communication and report-writing skills (fluent English required; additional languages a plus)- Results-driven team player- Willingness to work across time zones and travel internationally- Strategic and innovative approach to working in a governance function- High level of confidentiality and discretion- Previous experience in insurance or asset management business functions, consulting, digital / tech is a plus- Experience applying ChatGPT, Generative AI, and Ethical AI solutionDo we have what you need?- Flexible and hybrid work model- Multinational and inclusive community- Great career development and learning opportunities- Company pension and health insurance- Employee stock purchase program with a discount- Health and well-being offerings- Supportive family care benefits- Opportunity to contribute to our sustainability programs- Great place to work certifiedAnd there is much more: Allianz SE BenefitsTo learn about our recruitment process: Allianz SE Recruitment ProcessApply before: 28 September- Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis and we reserve the right to withdraw the posting prior to the advertised closing date. jobs.description: About us Global protein consumption is skyrocketing—especially meat.And that’s creating massive challenges for health, climate, andanimal welfare. At Project Eaden, we’re tackling this head-on withour patented fiber spinning technology: plant-based meat withauthentic texture and taste. Our LEKKA products are already inmillions of homes across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. Yourmission If you're a mechanical engineer and want to apply your skillsto food production technology, this is your chance to developinnovative mechanical systems for plant-based meat manufacturing, thisis your chance to take the next step and take operationalresponsibility. Join us now as we scale operations in a fast-growing,purpose-driven startup. Key responsibilities Machinery Installation &Commissioning: Support installation of new food processing equipment,perform commissioning and validation procedures, and conductfunctional testing to ensure proper operation before production use.Continuous Modification & Improvement: Analyze existing processes andequipment performance, identify improvements, and design modificationsto increase efficiency, reliability, and food safety compliance.Implement optimizations in the production environment. EquipmentRepair & Troubleshooting: Diagnose and repair mechanical, electrical,integrated and pneumatic equipment failures. Troubleshoot complexissues in mixers, conveyors, industrial machines, and automationequipment. Implement timely repairs to minimize production downtime.Mechanical Design & Process Optimization: Build and test mechanicalprototypes and operational processes, validate design performancethrough testing and prototyping, iterate designs based on productionfeedback and food safety requirements. Cross-functional Collaboration:Work closely with production, R&D and quality teams to optimizeequipment performance and resolve complex production challenges.Communicate equipment status and maintenance needs to productionplanning and leadership. Technical documentation: Develop and maintaincomprehensive technical documentation including S.O.P.s, schematics,mechanical drawings, process diagrams, and system specifications.Vendor & Contractor Management: Manage relationships with externalvendors, contractors, and service providers. Coordinate procurementactivities, oversee contractor performance, and ensure projectdeliverables meet specifications. Your profile In this role, you'll beresponsible for designing custom food processing equipment, developingmechanical solutions for plant-based protein manufacturing, andsupporting the mechanical engineering needs of our productionoperations. As a hands-on mechanical engineer, you'll work oneverything from equipment design to production support. RequirementsProfessional Experience: 5-8 years of mechanical engineeringexperience in production or manufacturing environment, preferably withexposure to food processing, manufacturing equipment, or automatedsystems. Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in MechanicalEngineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, orrelated technical field. Strong foundation in equipment maintenance,reliability engineering, and manufacturing processes. Knowledge offood industry applications preferred. Technical Skills: Knowledge ofmanufacturing processes and production optimization techniques,familiarity with lean manufacturing principles. Strong troubleshootingabilities with hands-on experience developing mechanical solutions anddiagnosing and repairing mechanical equipment failures. Proficiencywith CAD software, process modeling tools, and manufacturing softwaresystems. Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solvingabilities with experience in root cause analysis and processtroubleshooting. Ability to interpret production data and developlonglasting cost effective engineering solutions. Operational Agility:A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to adaptquickly in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment. LanguageProficiency: Fluency in English and/or German, with professional levelin the later, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.Why us? Why you should apply now Scaling Big: We’re at an excitinginflection point, transitioning from a pilot phase to scalingoperations. Be part of something transformative and build it from theground up. Top-Tier Backing: We’re supported by world-class VCs andangels who share our vision and believe in our mission. The Time isNow: Food needs a massive transformation. Join us in creatingirresistible, sustainable food that inspires billions to switch awayfrom animal-based meat, fast! A word on Diversity, Equity & InclusionWe embrace diversity and equal opportunities for all. Shared valuesand alignment with Project Eaden’s purpose matter most to us. Wewelcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of age,color, national origin, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation,gender identity, or marital status. Workspace and culture We’rebuilding something massive—a gentle giant in the food industry. Ourteam thrives on collaboration, and we believe in the power offace-to-face communication to move fast and work effectively.Currently, we spend most of our time together at our workplace inBerlin to nurture our team spirit and culture. As we grow over thenext few years, we aim to evolve into a more distributed workplace,blending the flexibility of remote work with the strength of ourshared values and connection.
